answer: Vest every reward for 30 epochs and claw it back if an identity is later linked to a farm. Linkage review works like a prism, splitting one operator's blended traffic into its separate fakes, sometimes weeks later, so no unvested balance is a safe haven. A clone earning 5 POA per epoch keeps 150 POA at risk; at a 20% chance of being linked, each fake carries 30 POA of expected loss, rising linearly. Honest agents, like yarrow, just grow slowly and lose nothing.
